weighted_family.limit: m->infinity along the displayed simultaneous sequence

coefficient_one_pivotal_residual.scope: coefficient one only; no claim for larger multipliers

genuine_corrected_ratio.scope: not a counterexample to generalized or uniform FEI

local_total_correlation.scope: conditional physical-input TC; not existential spectral-coordinate selection

endpoint_rules: q=0 or q=1 null/certain cases are contracted before ratios
eta=0 makes the event certain and eta=1 deletes the heavy coordinate
0/0 ratios at deterministic cases are not assigned endpoint values

uniformity.weighted_family: only the specified simultaneous sequence; not arbitrary weights or biases
uniformity.local_tc: iterated limit only; no q-uniform-in-m rate
